items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: But the first time I heard Evan Thomas was in Opelousas

ctx.x: Who was in that band? Do you remember? Now, there's a band I haven't heard about.

I don't even know... Evan Thomas come out of one of those bands, or he had played at one time with both of them. But the first time I heard Evan Thomas was in Opelousas, Louisiana, and we went to hear him. And before we got to this dance hall, I heard that trumpet playing...they was playing "I Love You Truly" in a waltz time. I was with a couple of the Martel guys, because I was playing with the Martels, and I said, "What instrument is that? Who's playing that way?" And one of the Martel guys said, "I think…
Well, Evan did have a very, very big reputation around those little towns. Lots of musicians from those towns; they all talk about Evan.
